1.name: HET-5 Red Fox
1.base_effect: Semi-Automatic material rifle that can penetrate up to 3 surfaces equipped with a scope that can identify targets through walls.

2.name: Marcom Mamba MGL
2.base_effect: Drum-loaded grenade launcher with high explosive grenades that immediately detonate on impact with characters or on a fuse if hitting the environment. Players and Civilians no longer take damage from the Mamba.

3.name: M135 Arges
3.base_effect: While firing the minigun or when it is spun up, you gain 10% armor damage reduction. Your total armor damage reduction from minigun perks cannot exceed 90%. Any additional bonus damage reduction will degrade by 1% per second whenever the gun is not firing. Unequipping the minigun will end all active bonuses.

4.name: Interceptor
4.base_effect: Blackout Protocol: As long as your OVERKILL meter is at least 25% full, you can activate it to disable all cameras on the heist temporarily. Once activated, your meter will drain over time. When your meter reaches 0, this skill’s effect will end. You can only use this skill once per heist and only if the alarm hasn’t been raised. [This ability replaces your OVK weapon]. This uses the “phone” player animation.

5.name: Sociopath
5.base_effect: If you have a full OVERKILL meter, you pull out a baseball bat on activation and drop any bag or body you are currently carrying. While you’re wielding the baseball bat, all incoming damage is done to your OVERKILL meter instead. You can use light or heavy swings with the bat, inflicting light or heavy damage. You’ll wield the bat until your OVERKILL meter reaches 0 or until you are downed. If you press the OVERKILL button while wielding the bat, your OVERKILL meter drops to 0. [This ability replaces your OVERKILL weapon.] Killing an enemy while this ability is active will restore 10% of your OVERKILL meter.

6.name: Karl Alfred M606
6.base_effect: This recoilless grenade launcher allows switching ammo types via mod options, each with different effects, damage, and behaviors. The gun gets delivered with three shots per standard. The gun also features a large backblast, causing damage and hurt reactions from enemies.

7.name: OVE9050
7.base_effect: Everyone's a hero until they hear the whirr of this monster from around the corner. Able to chew through most reasonably sized obstacles, this baby will turn closed to open before you have the time to say vroom-vroom.

1.name: Frag Grenade
1.description: Throw the grenade, grenade goes boom. Hold it longer, it'll go boom faster. Tale as old as time.

2.name: Flashbang Grenade
2.description: Stun your enemies with a blinding light! Flashbanged cops make the best human shields.

3.name: Smoke Grenade
3.description: Enemies caught in your smokescreen will aim worse and move slower. If they've got asthma, they're screwed.

4.name: Throwing Knife
4.description: Use this ninja shit for a quiet kill, but remember to retrieve it from the body. Knives ain't cheap.

5.name: Shock Grenade
5.description: If you want your bacon extra crispy, this is just the thing for you. Throw it into a pack of cops, and watch them fry!

6.name: Studsgranat S18
6.description: A grenade that hits the ground, then springs upward to detonate at face level.

1.name: Armor Bag
1.description: Repairs your lost armor. Bite the bullet before the bullet bites you.

2.name: Medic Bag
2.description:
Replenishes some of your health and number of downs. You'll never need a doctor again!
If you heal beyond your maximum health, you gain Adrenaline, which acts as a temporary layer of extra health.

3.name: Ammo Bag
3.description: Restocks a portion of your ammo and throwables, which are key ingredients to not dying.

4.name: Sentry Turret
4.description: An automated ally for shootouts. The singularity's coming, so enjoy friendly robots while you can!

1.name: Micro Cam
1.description:
Drop this spy camera anywhere, access it any time. Good for marking enemies and stalking crushes.

You can place 4 Micro Cams at a time by default. This number will increase if you raise your carrying capacity with skills or armor frames.

2.name: Motion Sensor
2.description:
Marks up to 15 enemies in a 3-meter range. If someone's voguing, you'll be the first to know.

You can place 4 Motion Sensors at any time by default. This number will increase if you raise your carrying capacity with skills or armor frames.

3.name: ECM Jammer
3.description:
Let's jam! While active, all cameras and radios work stupid slow. Stack for stronger effects.

You can place 2 ECM Jammers at any time by default. This number will increase if you raise your carrying capacity with skills or armor frames.

4.name: Infrasonic Mine
4.description:
A sonic stun device, audible only to your victims. Be ready to shut them up when it wears off.

You can place 10 Infrasonic Mines at any time by default. This number will increase if you raise your carrying capacity with skills or armor frames.

5.name: Trip Laser
5.description:
Slap this nifty lil' guy on a wall, and its sensor will mark anyone who passes by for ten seconds.

You can place 2 Trip Lasers at any time by default. This number will increase if you raise your carrying capacity with skills or armor frames.

1.name: Medtech Frame
1.description: First Aid Kits replenish an additional {FirstAidPackHealthPerCharge} health {FirstAidPackHealthPerCharge}|plural(one=point,other=points).

2.name: Specialist Frame
2.description: If you have a tool in your loadout, you start the heist with {ToolCount} additional {ToolCount}|plural(one=tool,other=tools) of that type. (This is applied before the Extra Pockets skill.)

3.name: Saboteur Frame
3.description: If you have no throwable for {NoThrowableReplenishDelay} {NoThrowableReplenishDelay}|plural(one=second,other=seconds), replenish {NoThrowableReplenishCount} {NoThrowableReplenishDelay}|plural(one=throwable,other=throwables).

4.name: Mercenary Frame
4.description: Whenever you kill an enemy, restore {KillEnemyTraumaRestore} {KillEnemyTraumaRestore}|plural(one=point,other=points) of trauma to your Armor Plate.

5.name: Vanguard Frame
5.description: Trading downs in favor of more ammo, this armor rewards aggression. It lets you harness the momentum of combat to replenish your armor plate trauma.

6.name: Survivalist Frame
6.description: More downs and armor chunks at the cost of some added weight. It helps you recover and stay standing under pressure.
